import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [14, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True, figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# 1. Top-left: Revenue by product (bar chart)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax1.bar(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(product_revenue)))
ax1.set_title('Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01,
             f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Top-middle: Sales distribution by age group (stacked bar)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
age_product = pd.crosstab(df['customer_age_group'], df['product'])
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_product = age_product.reindex(age_order)
age_product.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax2, colormap='Set2')
ax2.set_title('Product Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
ax2.legend(title='Product', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 3. Top-right: Payment method distribution (pie chart)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('pastel')[0:len(payment_counts)]
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)

# 4. Middle-left: Takeaway vs Dine-in revenue (grouped bar)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
takeaway_revenue = df.groupby(['is_takeaway', 'product'])['total'].sum().unstack().fillna(0)
takeaway_revenue.index = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
takeaway_revenue.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, colormap='tab20c', width=0.8)
ax4.set_title('Revenue: Takeaway vs Dine-in by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Service Type')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax4.legend(title='Product', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 5. Middle-center: Price distribution by size (box plot)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='size', y='price', order=size_order, ax=ax5, palette='Blues')
ax5.set_title('Price Distribution by Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Size')
ax5.set_ylabel('Price ($)')

# 6. Middle-right: Quantity distribution (histogram)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
sns.histplot(data=df, x='quantity', bins=range(1, df['quantity'].max()+2), 
             kde=True, ax=ax6, color='steelblue')
ax6.set_title('Distribution of Quantity per Transaction', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Quantity')
ax6.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax6.set_xticks(range(1, df['quantity'].max()+1))

# 7. Bottom: Hourly revenue pattern (line chart)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_revenue = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax7.plot(hourly_revenue.index, hourly_revenue.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, 
         markersize=8, color='darkorange')
ax7.fill_between(hourly_revenue.index, 0, hourly_revenue.values, alpha=0.3, color='darkorange')
ax7.set_title('Hourly Revenue Pattern', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
ax7.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)')
ax7.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add overall title
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
